segments.he: וְאִם הָיָה עוֹשֶׂה אֵצֶל כּוּ׳. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: מְסַתְּתֵי אֲבָנִים – אֵין בָּהֶם מִשּׁוּם גָּזֵל. מְפַסְּגֵי אִילָנוֹת, מְפַסְּגֵי גְפָנִים, מְנַקְּפֵי הִיגֵי, מְנַכְּשִׁי זְרָעִים וְעוֹדְרֵי יְרָקוֹת – בִּזְמַן שֶׁבַּעַל הַבַּיִת מַקְפִּיד עֲלֵיהֶם, יֵשׁ בָּהֶן מִשּׁוּם גָּזֵל; אֵין בַּעַל הַבַּיִת מַקְפִּיד עֲלֵיהֶן, הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ שֶׁלּוֹ.
segments.en: The mishna teaches: «And if he was doing» his work «in» the domain of the customer, then even the sawdust belongs to the customer. «The Sages taught» in a baraita (Tosefta 11:18): «Stone chiselers are not in» violation of a transgression «due to» the prohibition against «robbery» if they take the leftover chips of rock. Furthermore, with regard to «those who prune trees, those who prune vines, those who trim shrubs, those who weed plants, and those who hoe vegetables,» the halakha is dependent upon the owner’s inclination: «When the owner is particular about» the plant trimmings, the workers «are in» violation of a transgression «due to» the prohibition against «robbery» if they take the trimmings, but if «the owner is not particular about them,» then «these» items «belong to» the workers.
